title: Love, In Perspective
story: This photograph was taken in Hallstatt, Austria, a lakeside village already famous for its fairy-tale beauty. But turn it 90 degrees: the mountain and its mirrored reflection on the still water form the shape of a heart, while the drifting cloud above becomes a pair of wings cradling it. What began as a simple landscape reveals itself through nature's perspective: a heart, set free to fly.
